name: Audit Log Semantics
description: Each mission MUST have an append-only `AuditLog.ndjson` audit log where each line records one change event with timestamp, editor attribution, and a list of changed cards (including link changes when applicable). Multi-card operations (including batch edits) MUST be recorded as a single audit entry describing all affected cards and link changes. Audit entries MUST be appended by the editor/tooling layer that performs validation-gated writes, not by agents or UI code writing files directly.
